# Tacoma Community College

> > Tacoma Community College (TCC) is a public community college in Tacoma, Washington, offering affordable higher education programs with a commitment to diversity, equity, and student success.

TCC serves the South Puget Sound region with comprehensive academic programs including healthcare education (Radiologic Sciences, Nursing, EMS), transfer degrees, and workforce training. The college emphasizes student achievement through the Student Achievement Initiative (SAI) and maintains strong support services through the Office of Equity, Diversity and Inclusion, Counseling Services, and the Bias Incident Response Team (BIRT).
